experiment.name: Add exact chi-square p-values with optional SciPy dependency
experiment.description: Compute and report chi-square survival-function p-values when SciPy is available, while preserving the no-SciPy fallback.
experiment.expectedOutput: summary.json gains p_value fields for first digit, second digit, and negative control; README documents optional dependency behavior.
experiment.claimSupported: Improves statistical reporting without changing the primary MAD-based conformity classification.
experiment.method: Add optional scipy.stats.chi2.sf import, store p_value fields in summary.json, document null fallback, and validate both normal SciPy and simulated no-SciPy execution paths.
experiment.successCriteria: Analysis remains reproducible; p-values are present when SciPy is installed and absent/null without failing when it is not.

commands_run: PYTHONPATH=<fake scipy shadow> python3 scripts/analyze_benford.py --data data/population.csv --results-dir results/no_scipy_validation --figures-dir figures/no_scipy_validation

without_scipy_simulated.note: SciPy is not available; chi-square p_value fields are null. Install scipy to compute exact survival-function p-values.

reproduceCommand: docker run -it -v "$PWD":/work -w /work python:3.11 bash -lc 'python -m pip install --no-cache-dir numpy pandas matplotlib scipy && python scripts/run_all.py --mode full --clean-smoke'
